neighbours.label: the piece 'EC' / ' FEC' in the letter string FEC (forward error correction, Federal Election Commission, Latin FEC-)
fire: Satellite links add FEC bits so the receiver can fix flipped bits.
The campaign's latest FEC filing showed a surge in small donations.
Optical networks use strong FEC to stretch signals over long cables.
Reporters combed through FEC records to trace the donor's money.
The old Roman stone bears the words FECIT ANNO beneath the name.
The streaming protocol enables FEC when packet loss rises above two percent.
A complaint was lodged with the FEC over the undisclosed advertising.
Engineers tuned the FEC overhead to balance speed against reliability.
quiet: Satellite links add parity bits so the receiver can fix flipped bits.
The campaign's latest SEC filing showed a surge in share buybacks.
Optical networks use strong amplifiers to stretch signals over long cables.
Reporters combed through IRS records to trace the donor's money.
The old Roman stone bears the words ANNO DOMINI beneath the name.
The streaming protocol enables ARQ when packet loss rises above two percent.

notes: Probe: 'error correction (FEC)' 1.14, Federal Election Commission ' FEC' 0.62, Latin FECERVNT 0.52, Figaro 'aro' 0.74 (also fires; not used as a near miss), ARQ 0.002, ECC 0.003, SEC 0.007. Tokenizer: 'FEC' mid-sentence -> ' FEC'; '(FEC' -> 'F','EC'.
